current_activity: Division Scharnhorst defends the Elbe bridgehead around Dessau against the US 3d Armored Division on 14 April
notes: Event date: CMH The Last Offensive ch. 17 p. 396: "the commanders of two divisions, Scharnhorst and Ulrich von Hutten, had committed their units as they became available to hold a bridgehead west of the Elbe around Dessau"; p. 401: "the 3d Armored hit positions of Division Scharnhorst and Division Ulrich von Hutten". Event definition: the contact of 14 April; the bridgehead was held earlier under OKW orders. Event support: one source family (CMH). Location: Dessau, Sachsen-Anhalt with a precision of 10 km. Location approximate: Dessau stands for the bridgehead area; the division headquarters is not placed. Location support: CMH names the bridgehead west of the Elbe around Dessau. Commander: unknown. Opponents: US 3d Armored Division.
